expressions: /* RGB LED demo, command method (needs the firmware built with WS2812_COMMANDS, the default). */ eol /* Registers used: 5-8 animation triggers (set by the mappings and the Calc toggle below), 32 steady colour. */ eol /* LED settings line: tag 0x4C4553 ("LES") + 00, then 0xWWLOOOPP: GPIO16, RGB order (123), full level, no power pin. */ eol /* It replaces register 31: no expression needed. Most WS2812B are GRB: use 0x00000010. */ eol 0x4C455300 0x00012310 eol /* Steady colour when no animation plays: register 32, dim white (0xIIRRGGBB). */ eol 0x10FFFFFF 32000 store eol /* Calc (0x000C0192) toggles register 8 on each press: rainbow on/off. Calc itself is mapped to Nothing. */ eol 0x000c0192 input_state_binary 0x000c0192 prev_input_state_binary not mul 8000 recall 0 eq 8000 recall ifte 8000 store

/* Animation lines: tag 0x4C4541 ("LEA") + trigger register (01-20 hex), then colour 0xIIRRGGBB and seconds, repeated. */ eol /* The animation loops while its register is not 0 and restarts each time the register turns on. */ eol /* Negative seconds = fade from this colour to the next one. When several play, the last line wins. */ eol /* register 5 (Keypad 1 held): police, red/blue every 0.125 s */ eol 0x4C454105 0xFFFF0000 125 0xFF0000FF 125 eol /* register 6 (Keypad 2 held): red blink, 0.25 s on, 0.25 s off */ eol 0x4C454106 0xFFFF0000 250 0x00000000 250

/* register 7 (Keypad 3 held): blue breathing, fade up 1 s (intensity 04 -> FF), fade down 1 s */ eol 0x4C454107 0x040000FF -1000 0xFF0000FF -1000 eol /* register 8 (Calc toggles): rainbow, fading red -> green -> blue -> red, 1 s each */ eol 0x4C454108 0x60FF0000 -1000 0x6000FF00 -1000 0x600000FF -1000
